name: Five Sinners
desc: Five prominent figures of Khaenri'ah, who shared the power of the Abyss, capable of destroying an entire world, among themselves.

customize.name: Vedrfolnir
customize.desc: One of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, also known as "The Visionary."

customize.text: "The Visionary," Dainsleif's older brother, who was blinded in both eyes for a prophecy made to King Irmin. It was during the release of Vedrfolnir from prison that he, along with four other prominent figures of the Khaenri'ah, shared the power of the Abyss.

customize.name: Rerir
customize.desc: One of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, also known as "Rächer of Solnari."

customize.text: "Rächer of Solnari," Dainsleif's friend. He was a secret agent in the service of King Irmin, who was destroying the descendants of the Crimson Moon. He used the power of the Abyss to bring back his beloved Tholindis.

customize.name: Surtalogi
customize.desc: One of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, also known as "The Foul."

customize.name: Skirk
customize.desc: A mysterious swordswoman from the Abyss and Tartaglia's master.

customize.name: All-Devouring Narwhal
customize.desc:
A mysterious and gargantuan creature from another world.

Poets often liken the starry sky to the ocean. They've seen or dreamt of countless bioluminescent plankton floating on a moonless sea, resembling a galaxy, or the moonlight ripped apart by waves on the sea's surface, like shimmering stars. In the most fantastical stories or outrageous lies, the stars found in the depths of the cosmos might be teeming with life, much like Teyvat, and the universe itself is akin to an ocean. Realistically speaking, however, if a profound universe full of life exists, why hasn't any of that life made contact with Teyvat?

Maybe the universe has been constantly trying to infiltrate Teyvat, or maybe a higher power created borders to protect this world.

customize.name: Rhinedottir
customize.desc: An alchemist, a member of the Hexenzirkel, one of the five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, and Albedo's mother. Rhinedottir created an army of shadowy monsters, who attacked Teyvat 500 years ago. She's also known as Gold and R.

customize.text: "Gold," a great alchemist who used Art of Khemia to create Rifthounds,

customize.name: Durin
customize.desc: The Shadow Dragon and one of Rhinedottir's children.

customize.name: Elynas
customize.desc: An Abyssal beast that appeared in Fontaine 500 years ago during the Cataclysm. Elynas is the "Father" of all Melusines.

customize.name: Albedo
customize.desc: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

customize.name: Hexenzirkel
customize.desc: A secret witch society, which discusses secrets at the tea parties and explores Irminsul. There are eight witches in the Hexenzirkel.

customize.text: . Her creations invaded Teyvat during the Cataclysm 500 years ago.

customize.name: Hroptatyr
customize.desc: One of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, also known as "The Wise."

customize.text: "The Wise," the president of the Universitas Magistrorum, and the Chief Royal Mage.

The Five Sinners were people who should have prevented the disaster and stopped the Vinster King from continuing to rock the foundation of the world. They couldn't resist the call of the Abyss, and divided among themselves a power that could destroy the world. They became transcendent beings with a world-shattering power.

customize.name: Dainsleif
customize.desc: A former captain of the Khaenri'ahn Royal Guard, who was cursed by Celestia with immortality.

customize.name: Abyss Order
customize.desc: An organization comprised of the cursed Khaenri'ahns and non-human monsters. They are the enemies of surface civilization and thrive in many corners of the world. Their main goal is to destroy the world under the rule of The Seven.
